async function resolveDoc(uuid) {

source?.sourceItem?.system?.props?.category,

source?.advPayload?.sourceType,

source?.meta?.sourceType,

source?.source,

phase?.sourceType,

phaseAction?.advPayload?.sourceType,

phaseAction?.meta?.sourceType,

source?.dataCore?.listType,

phaseAction?.dataCore?.skillName

const category = lc(categoryRaw);

range.includes("melee") ||

range === "close";

range.includes("ranged") ||

range === "range" ||

range.includes("far") ||

range.includes("long");

(!rangeRaw && categoryImpliesRanged);

categoryRaw,

sourceType,

listType,

skillType,

weaponUuid: weaponDoc?.uuid ?? null,

rangeSaysMelee,

NaN

source?.hasAccuracy ||

phase?.hasAccuracy ||

source?.accuracy?.isCrit ||

actorUuid: actor?.uuid ?? null,

const effectName = String(effectData.name ?? effectData.label ?? "").trim();

for (const target of hitTargets) {

const targetActor = await resolveActor(target.uuid);

if (!targetActor) {

results.push({ target: target.name, ok: false, reason: "target_actor_not_found" });
